qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Mainframe zSystems and Red Hat OpenShift create high enterprise switching costs, but empirical proof of moat fails: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~10.5%, below the 12% hurdle, while IT Consulting (~30%+ of revenue) lacks structural pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & lack of pricing power, REJECT). Multi-year median GAAP ROIC of ~10.5% fails the 12% hurdle. High switching costs in zSystems mainframes and Red Hat cannot overcome lack of pricing power in IT Consulting (~30%+ of revenue) and exposure to AI automation headwinds.
qualitative.evidence: Historical GAAP ROIC median is 10.5% (2020-2024 range: 5.9% to 10.1%), missing the 12% proof-of-moat hurdle. IT Consulting segment faces wage inflation and commoditization. Total debt is ~$61B (including financing debt) against $10.6B GAAP Net Income in 2025.
